subject: Follow-up on your large upload failures (MetaDefender ICAP Server)
body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for your time today. Here is a quick recap.

What we found: uploads over about 50 MB fail after roughly a minute because MetaDefender ICAP Server stops waiting 60 seconds for the scan result of large zip archives, then returns the 500 error to your portal.

Next steps:
1. Me: confirm the exact timeout and archive settings in the documentation and send you the steps.
2. You: send the full ICAP Server log for one failed upload and the size of your largest zip, this afternoon.
3. Me: follow up with what to test once you have applied the steps.

Please hold off changing the timeout until you have my steps, so we only change one thing at a time.

More background on the timeout setting: https://docs.example-opswat.invalid/icap/configuration/scan-timeouts

claims_needing_verification.claim: The 60-second ICAP timeout is the sole cause of the failures.
claims_needing_verification.reason: Core archive limits may also play a part; not yet confirmed.
